detail.longDescription: What do Lil Jon, Matthew McConaughey, and Mandy Moore have in common? The common thread isn't backing vocals on "Get Low" or cameos in Interstellar—it's actually email marketing. All of them use Kit (formerly ConvertKit). And while you won't find quite as many celebrities bragging about their Mailchimp usage, it's an essential tool for businesses as diverse as the Georgia Museum of Art, Jittery Joe's Coffee, and a brand of baby sunglasses called Babiators.
